title: Forever Pack
description: A lightweight modpack featuring various quality of life mods, performance mods, and a couple new features. Designed to work primarily in conjunction with a server.
body: This pack aims to provide a generally elevated vanilla experience, while being lightweight and more or less able to adapt to upcoming Minecraft updates. It is somewhat "custom" to be used with in conjunction with a server, with the idea this is the last and greatest world me and my friends will ever play, but can be used as a baseline or "jumping off point" for other modpacks. No extra content is added aside a couple of decoration items such as trims and furniture packs.
